# Pure-MIND native-ELF oracle (RI-D slice 1, task #110). Frozen from the pure-MIND
# compiler stage1.elf (testdata/selfhost_loop/stage1.elf) — NOT the retired old-Rust
# src/native backend (deleted in #15; its historical snapshot is native_elf_oracle/).
# These are the canonical byte anchors for the native bridge
# (gate: backend_native_bridge_smoke.py).
#
# compiler:  testdata/selfhost_loop/stage1.elf (frozen pure-MIND stage0)
# std_blob:  21 modules, sha256 6c269ee7082a993dc48f83e70fdccf19f2b6252a479c22f40dc9a454c4e464bc (380832 bytes)
# programs:  each row's source is <name>.mind in this directory; the gate reads the
#            manifest and iterates every row. Previously the gate hardcoded ONE
#            program, so "byte anchor" meant a single 492-byte artifact and a
#            regression in any other shape was invisible to CI.
#              add           a + b through a user fn            -> exit 5
#              const_return  the minimal program                -> exit 7
#              local_call    call a local helper                -> exit 7
#              while_sum     while-loop accumulate 0..9         -> exit 45
# wire:      stdin [8B user_lo LE][8B src_len LE][std_blob ++ program]; ELF -> stdout
#
# name  size_bytes  sha256  expected_exit_code
add           492  2c6f923330882fa1324bbf4170d9f805a486f76225436c564f69a24d2f022c26  5
const_return  397  8734bc4c3ee1962760222135855ca7f1290c41e5ceeb03a8ac944328679a8b9b  7
local_call    474  f72c53019d3e83afcdf4a86afa63020a7b720f12e952bfbc4697551d0192c520  7
while_sum     581  e442c8a5fb3b82061126a4d4c114a66de5af972dbbccf73f13a80b8bbe0738c0  45
#
# Old-Rust divergence (native_elf_oracle/add.elf, sha b20651a5..., same 492B): 31 of 492
# bytes differ, ALL in the tail (bytes 461-492). ELF header, entry (0x400120), program
# headers, and the first 460 bytes are byte-identical. The two emitters are near-twins;
# the pure-MIND output is deterministic run-to-run and is the canonical RI-D reference.
